name: com.cashfree.pg.ui.hidden.checkout.CashfreeNativeCheckoutActivity
description: When the app opens Cashfree native checkout, this screen loads the available payment methods, such as UPI, cards, wallets, pay-later, EMI, and net banking. Disabling it removes the app's Cashfree payment screen.
disableEffect: Users may be unable to pay through Cashfree native checkout.
